pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's Theorem environment at source lines 527-530 (label 4.2), the existence of ordered partitions of the levels with uniform successor numbers between consecutive pieces; the proof environment at source lines 532-551 immediately follows it and is its own proof. The proof refines the partitions along a schedule hitting every level infinitely often and concludes by eventual constancy on finite levels; all of it is inside the counted span. The counted spans contain no reference to any labelled item and no bibliography citation, so the card carries no navigation stub and no bibliography excerpt.
